rules.rationale: Defines the named domain predicate definedProjectInt as the existing sort test isInt.
Asserts the definedness characterization of the built-in partial Val-to-Int cast; it is a simplification fact about the cast domain and has no prior exact proof in Stage 1.
Defines the named projectInt proof term by the built-in partial Int cast under its explicit definedness guard.
Provides the reverse definitional orientation between the guarded built-in Int cast and the named projectInt term.
Defines the projectInt collapse equation on values already of sort Int.
Defines the rowVals structural projection for a list value by returning its contained ValSeq.
Defines the named isListVal predicate through equality with the list reconstructed from rowVals.
Defines the empty-sequence base case of the recursive allBinary domain predicate.
Defines the structurally recursive nonempty case of allBinary, including the exact 0-or-1 head condition.
Defines the empty-grid base case of the recursive allRows domain predicate.
Defines the structurally recursive nonempty case of allRows from isListVal, allBinary, and the remaining rows.
Defines the zero base case of the mathematical rowSum recurrence.
Defines the nonempty rowSum recurrence by adding the head's integer value to the tail summary.
Defines bucketCost for positive capacity using the exact integer-floor expression summarized by the proof.
Defines the disjoint nonpositive-capacity totalization branch of bucketCost.
Defines the empty-grid base case of the gridCost recurrence.
Defines the nonempty gridCost recurrence as the head-row bucket cost plus the tail-grid cost.
Defines finalRow on an empty suffix as the previously bound loop-target value.
Defines the structurally recursive finalRow step by carrying the current head as the new previous value.
